description: Janglim is an embeddable LALR parser-generator engine for .NET with C# and EBNF grammars, longest-match lexing, parser-driven token sources, and registered C# predicates. Includes ECMAScript 2026 strict Script and Module profiles with static syntax validation. Inspect parsing tables, FIRST/FOLLOW sets, traces, syntax trees, and diagnostics, with incremental reparsing and pluggable error recovery.
releaseNotes: Janglim 0.5.0 adds longest-match registered-rule lexing with stable equal-length priority and no automatic word boundaries. Parser-driven token sources use lexical policies and independent cursors for contextual reads and prediction. ECMAScript 2026 strict Script/Module profiles cover expressions, templates, destructuring, functions, async/generators, object methods, classes, modules, and regular-expression body checks. Check both Parsing and Validate results. Review regex behavior when upgrading from 0.4.0. LALRParser remains supported; the public API retains its 0.x policy. Full release notes: https://github.com/AJ-comp/Compiler/blob/master/RELEASE_NOTES.md
